'''Tam''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the younger brother of [[Irek]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] showed a hologram of the two children playing in the park and warned [[Bant'ena Fhernan|Bant'ena]] that if she refused to help the Separatists, he would [[Death/Legends|kill]] them.
